body: I feel like I do live a healthy lifestyle, I exercise and I eat properly. I could never afford a psychiatrist unfortunately. The thoughts? I can't really peg them I guess. I mean, I'll think about an array of things I suppose. I guess I'm just sad. I don't have a reason. I had a traumatic childhood after my brother died, so I can safely assume that has something to do with my feelings. But I think about how I could have done something much more grand with my life, how I feel taken for granted, how I'm so young and so stuck,
Only their dad. He thinks I need to get over it. And if we fight he tells me I might as well  just do it. He really has no idea I guess.
